mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_statistics ( statistics_date, total_order_count, completed_order_count, canceled_order_count, total_sales_amount, aggregated_at ) SELECT #{statisticsDate}, COUNT(statistics_order.id), COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN statistics_order.status = 'PICKED_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0), COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN statistics_order.status IN ('CANCELED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0), ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(statistics_payment.amount), 0) FROM payments AS statistics_payment WHERE statistics_payment.status = 'DONE' AND statistics_payment.approved_at >= #{start} AND statistics_payment.approved_at < #{end} ), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM orders AS statistics_order WHERE statistics_order.created_at >= #{start} AND statistics_order.created_at < #{end} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_order_count = VALUES(total_order_count), completed_order_count = VALUES(completed_order_count), canceled_order_count = VALUES(canceled_order_count), total_sales_amount = VALUES(total_sales_amount), aggregated_at = VALUES(aggregated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(MIN(statistics_order.created_at)) FROM orders AS statistics_order
SELECT DATE(MIN(statistics_payment.approved_at)) FROM payments AS statistics_payment WHERE statistics_payment.approved_at IS NOT NULL
